# `state/consistency/CRDT.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/consistency/CRDT.js`

state/consistency/CRDT.js — approved mergeable types (spec §4 "Mergeable state", rule 14/36).  State-based CRDTs (CvRDTs): every type exposes a `merge(other)` that is a least-upper-bound join — associative, commutative, and idempotent — so replicas that exchange state in any order/any number of times converge to the same value WITHOUT coordination (CALM / coordination-avoidance). Each merge is non-mutating and returns a NEW instance so the join algebra is easy to test.  IMPORTANT (rule 36): CRDT convergence is NOT proof of application validity. A CRDT may only be used for a value after `InvariantConfluence` confirms its operations preserve the relevant invariants. These types are the approved building blocks, not a license to make any value mergeable.
